scope: declares AL canonical boundary and public proof rules
proof_rules: Canonical claims must be indexed in _truth/receipts/index.json.
Canonical receipts must be content-addressed by sha256.
Canonical receipts require CA signature binding before public authority is asserted.
WK or working keys are rejected for canonical promotion.
Visual art and narrative summaries are public presentation surfaces, not truth surfaces.
Epoch closure requires a threshold signature over the final root before freeze.
